item.title: Date is out, Temporal is in
item.description:
📝 log( new Date(2026, 1, 1) ); // Result: Date Sun Feb 01 2026 00:00:00 GMT-0500 (Eastern Standard Time) The Date constructor. log( new Date( "100" ) ); // Result: Date Fri Jan 01 0100 00:00:00 GMT-0456 (Eastern Standard Time) I dislike Date immensely. log( new Date('2026-01-02') ); // Result: Date Thu Jan 01 2026 19:00:00 GMT-0500 (Eastern Standard Time) Date sucks.
🔗 Read more: https://piccalil.li/blog/date-is-out-and-temporal-is-in/

item.title: Show HN: AI in SolidWorks
item.description:
📝 A SolidWorks add-in to design with natural language using AI Describe your design in plain language and LAD will translate it into SolidWorks operations, creating sketches, features, and assemblies all through natural conversation. When writing macros, LAD searches SolidWorks documentation and examples to better understand the API. LAD (Language-Aided Designer) is a system that integrates directly into SolidWorks as an Add-in and can create sketches, features, macros, and other CAD objects.
🔗 Read more: https://www.trylad.com

item.description:
